audit.whatIsWrong: Olaf's W is called 'Vicious Strikes' throughout the content layer, and no cooldowns appear anywhere.
audit.why: Riot's current name for Olaf's W is Tough It Out. Ragnarok is 100/90/80s and grants disable immunity while he keeps attacking, so Riposte returns damage and a slow but no stun. Undertow is a flat 9s whose cooldown resets when he picks the axe back up — denying the pickup is the real punish. Reckless Swing is 11/10/9/8/7s true damage.
audit.corrected: Ability renamed and the three timers written into breakdown.cooldowns and phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: sequencing advice named Ragnarok with no duration and never mentioned the axe-pickup reset.
audit.why: The axe reset is the reason his Q pressure feels permanent; walking over the axe first is the concrete counterplay.

edits.before: Olaf's early game runs on Undertow (Q) — it slows you so he can stick for a Vicious Strikes trade, and when it lands he can re-pick the axe to refund most of its cooldown. The trade rule is simple: sidestep the axe and his pressure collapses, because he has to walk over to retrieve it and his slow is gone. When he whiffs, Lunge in, weave your E Bladework crit into a Vital, and chunk him before he recovers. Your level 2-3 combo beats his — just don't stand in the axe and don't trade into his Vicious Strikes lifesteal when he's at full health.
edits.after: Olaf's early game runs on Undertow (Q) — it slows you so he can stick for a Tough It Out (W) trade, and when it lands he can walk over the axe to reset its 9s cooldown outright. The trade rule is simple: sidestep the axe and his pressure collapses, because he has to walk over to retrieve it and his slow is gone. When he whiffs, Lunge in, weave your E Bladework crit into a Vital, and chunk him before he recovers. Your level 2-3 combo beats his — just don't stand in the axe and don't trade into his W shield when he's at full health.

notes: The content layer used the retired name 'Vicious Strikes' for Olaf's W in five places; Riot's current name is Tough It Out and it is a shield plus attack speed, not a lifesteal buff. I corrected four of them (whys[5], spikes[2].text, wants.foe[0], early) and left 'mid' and 'late' alone this pass so the edit set stays reviewable — both still carry the wrong name and the wrong effect description, and should be corrected in a follow-up.
